subject.title: fix: Windows /restart falls back to in-process restart without changing PID

question: Should env-less native Windows gateway restarts probe Scheduled Tasks directly, and if so must the probe resolve the exact default/profile/custom task name before the gateway exits?
rationale: The fix touches a compatibility-sensitive restart fallback where a false positive can stop the current gateway, while doing nothing leaves `/restart` as an in-process reload for the reported Windows setup.

options.title: Require Exact Scheduled Task Detection
options.body: Proceed only if the linked PR probes the same task name the handoff will run and includes redacted Windows `/restart` plus `/status` proof.

options.title: Keep Env Markers As The Contract
options.body: Reject direct probing and document that manually started Windows gateways without service markers use in-process restart unless launched through the Scheduled Task.

options.title: Accept Default-Task-Only Scope
options.body: Allow probing only the default task and explicitly own the profile/custom-name false-negative or false-positive risk.

recommendation.title: Require Exact Scheduled Task Detection
recommendation.body: Proceed only if the linked PR probes the same task name the handoff will run and includes redacted Windows `/restart` plus `/status` proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The Windows Scheduled Task restart path and supervisor marker handling most directly trace to their merged work.
